notes: Coastal curios from a small harbour town: pilings, a winch, a lantern cluster, a shell collection and a ship in miniature. Core pieces are the dock-side basics; the rares are the lamps, the model ship and the pilings with the sea round them. Tagged town:cove in the catalog.

entries.why: Plain dock piling, the first thing at any quay
Shells, a starfish and sea glass picked from the strand
A ship in miniature, the harbour's keepsake
Three pilings bound together, 2x2 dockside centrepiece
A piling standing in the lapping surf
Iron dock winch with its rope drum
